title: Nine Autumns and One Coat
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：autumn　|　正文 318 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 autumn 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my grandmother said the ① autumn had come early and my grandfather said it always did, and they were both right. The ② autumn, meaning the weather and not the month, lasted nine weeks and gave them one fine day; an autumn, she said, is the only season that admits it is leaving. She said the spring never admits anything at all.

Every ③ autumn in that house began with the same coat and the same argument about the coat. Their ④ autumn in 1961 had nine frosts before November and no apples; an autumn, my father said, is the only time of year that is measured by what is taken away. He said what is left is never counted.

My grandfather used the word the other way in 1974 and said he was in ⑤ the autumn of his life, which my grandmother said was a phrase borrowed from a book. The ⑥ autumn, meaning the late part of a thing and not the season, is the only metaphor that everybody agrees on and nobody means; an autumn, he said, is either nine weeks of weather or a way of saying nearly done. He said he preferred the second.

By 1969 the ⑦ autumn had become a job: nine days of lifting, four of burning, and one of standing still. The ⑧ autumn she liked best was 1953, when the rain held off and the whole village came out; an autumn, my mother said, is the only season that people describe by what they managed to finish. She said 1953 was the only one she finished.

The ⑨ autumn I remember is the one in 1965, which had nine fine days in a row and fooled everybody. An ⑩ autumn, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that is beautiful because it is failing; every autumn, she said, is a lesson that nobody learns twice. She said she had been taught eleven times.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 秋天；秋季（一个具体的秋天）
B. n. 秋天（指天气，与月份相对）
C. n. 秋天（指 1961 年那一个）
D. n. 秋天（比喻：事物的后期、晚年）
E. n. 后期；衰落期（抽象比喻）
F. n. 秋天（指变成一项活儿的那些秋天）
G. n. 秋天（指她最喜欢的那一个）
H. n. 秋天（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: The autumn, meaning the weather and not the month
The autumn, meaning the late part of a thing
the autumn had become a job
An autumn, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: autumn 意为“秋天、秋季”，1958 年祖母说那年秋天来得早，祖父说它一向如此，两人都是对的。
autumn 指“天气”，与月份相对，那年秋天持续了九个星期，只给了他们一个好天。
autumn 意为“秋天”，那屋里每一个秋天都是从同一件大衣、以及关于这件大衣的同一场争论开始的。
autumn 指 1961 年那一个秋天，十一月之前就有九次霜，一个苹果也没有。
autumn 为比喻义，意为“事物的后期、晚年”，1974 年祖父说自己到了人生的秋天，祖母说那是从书里借来的说法。
autumn 意为“后期、衰落期（抽象比喻）”，与季节相对，它是人人都认同、却没人真当真的比喻。
autumn 指变成一项活儿的那些秋天，到 1969 年秋天成了一项工作：九天搬抬，四天焚烧，一天站着不动。
autumn 指她最喜欢的那一个，她最喜欢的秋天是 1953 年，那年雨没有落下来，全村人都出了门。
autumn 意为“秋天”，我记得的是 1965 年那个秋天，它连着给了九个好天，把所有人都骗了。
autumn 为抽象总称，泛指“秋天这种东西”，祖母说秋天是唯一因为正在衰败才显得美的事物。
